answer: An agent marketplace grants one bidding slot per identity against a separate $100 bond with a minimum 30-day lock. Withdrawing the bond disables the slot; accounts named island, zenith and plume cannot share a deposit. An attacker seeking ten extra slots must lock $1,000, so renaming agents cannot create free capacity. Each added identity requires $100 of capital and, at a 12% annual funding rate, about $1 in financing for the minimum lock. The principal remains refundable.
